summary: Recursive merge sort on a singly linked list of nodes, ascending by the float key stored at (data pointer + 4) of each node's payload. Counts the nodes, returns early for null or fewer-than-2 nodes, splits the list at its midpoint, sorts each half recursively (this same function), then merges the two sorted halves in ascending float-key order, relinking the node next pointers. Returns the head of the merged list. Used by EntityVisibilityGridManager.

local_names.a1: head of the singly linked list to sort
local_names.v8: current node being walked in the right half during merge
local_names.v9: current node being walked in the left half during merge
local_names.v10: tail of the merged output being built

operations.description: Return a1 unchanged when the list head is null (empty list).
Count list nodes by walking the next pointer at node offset 4, tracking the count in the node-count field.
Return a1 unchanged when the node count is below 2 (trivially sorted).
Compute the split index as (node count / 2) minus 1.
Advance the walk pointer from the head by the split index to reach the midpoint node, following node offset 4.
Split the list: capture the right half head from the midpoint node's next pointer, then write 0 into that next pointer to terminate the left half.
Recursively sort the left half via this same MergeSortOnLinkedList routine.
Recursively sort the right half via this same MergeSortOnLinkedList routine.
Return the non-null sorted half when either half is empty.
Compare the float keys: read the key at (data pointer + 4) of the left head node and the right head node, each node's data pointer at node offset 0.
Select the smaller-key node as the head of the merged list (ascending order).
Merge the remaining nodes of both halves, relinking node next pointers (offset 4) to the smaller key each step until one half is exhausted.
Terminate the merged tail: link the remaining nodes of the non-empty half, or write 0 as the null sentinel when both halves are exhausted.
Return the head of the merged ascending list.
Invoked by EntityVisibilityGridManager to order entity entries by their float key.
